claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Vecuronium is a quaternary ammonium nicotinic acetylcholine receptor antagonist that is not cytotoxic at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak effects reflecting nonspecific cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a receptor-mediated killing mechanism.
